questions.question: Dr. Karim must train young dentists in AMO agreement. What is the first piece of advice he should give them?
options: The agreement is an administrative constraint
The agreement is a tool serving the patient and the practitioner
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'The agreement is a tool serving the patient and the practitioner, guaranteeing access to care.' Dr. Nadia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must create an agreement training center. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The main objective is to train dentists in agreement management.' Dr. Karim: 'I will participate in this training.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must evaluate a young dentist's agreement performance. Which measure is most important?
options: The quality of file management and rule compliance
The number of AMO patients treated
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'The quality of file management and rule compliance are the most important measures.' Dr. Nadia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must manage a crisis: a patient has filed a complaint for non-reimbursement. What is the priority?
options: Protect the patient and the practice's reputation
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The priority is to protect the patient and the practice's reputation.' Dr. Karim: 'I will help you manage this crisis.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must train interns in agreement risk management. What is the fundamental principle?
options: Risk management is a professional responsibility
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Agreement risk management is a fundamental professional responsibility.' Dr. Nadia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must create a guide to good agreement practices. What is the main reference?
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Good practices must be based on Law 65-00 and its implementing decrees.' Dr. Karim: 'I will contribute to this guide.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must train young dentists in AMO billing. What is the key message?
options: Billing must be rigorous and comply with the nomenclature
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Billing must be rigorous and comply with the nomenclature to avoid any dispute.' Dr. Nadia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must create a research program on agreement. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Research on agreement aims to improve dentists' practices.' Dr. Karim: 'I will participate in the research.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must manage a reference practice in agreement. What is the pillar of excellence?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Excellence is based on agreement compliance and transparency toward the patient.' Dr. Nadia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must evaluate the impact of the agreement on public health. What is the role of the agreement?
options: It is essential for access to care
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The agreement is essential to guarantee access to care for all.' Dr. Karim: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must train interns in innovation in agreement. What current trend is important?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Innovation concerns dematerialization, new technologies, and new AMO challenges.' Dr. Nadia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must create an agreement skills assessment system. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Skills assessment aims to improve agreement practices.' Dr. Karim: 'I will participate in the assessment.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must manage an ethical conflict related to the agreement. What is the right attitude?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Law 65-00 is the guide for resolving ethical conflicts related to the agreement.' Dr. Nadia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must write an article on the future of the agreement. What trend should be highlighted?
options: Innovation in service of access to care
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The future of the agreement is based on innovation in service of access to care.' Dr. Karim: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must create a quality label for practices in agreement. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Agreement compliance and transparency are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Nadia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must give a speech on the importance of the agreement. What message should she convey?
options: The agreement is a pillar of social security
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The agreement is a pillar of social security and access to care.' Dr. Karim: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must create a scholarship for agreement students. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Encouraging excellence in agreement is an investment for the future.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must pass on her agreement knowledge. What is the most effective method?
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Personalized mentoring and practical cases are the most effective methods.' Dr. Karim: 'I will get involved in mentoring.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must create a peer network for young contracted dentists. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual support and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Mutual support and sharing are essential for young contracted dentists.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must write a conclusion to her book on the agreement. What is the final sentence?
options: The agreement is the heart of access to care
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The agreement is the heart of access to care.' Dr. Karim: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Agreement values and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Agreement values and the example are the most beautiful legacy one can leave.' Dr. Nadia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must train future agreement mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of values
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of values.' Dr. Karim: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must write a letter to future dentists about the agreement. What message should he convey?
options: The agreement is a fundamental pillar of the profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'The agreement is a fundamental pillar of the profession.' Dr. Nadia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must create an award for young dentists in agreement. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Stimulating excellence in agreement is essential for the evolution of the profession.' Dr. Karim: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim, after a career dedicated to the agreement, receives national recognition. Dr. Nadia is by his side. What is Dr. Karim's message to young dentists?
options: The agreement is the heart of social security
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim concludes: 'The agreement is the heart of social security. It gives meaning to our practice.' Dr. Nadia: 'I am proud of you.'
